title: Data and variables
summary: Store information in variables, learn the basic kinds of data, and write programs that talk to the user.
outcomes: Store values in variables and give them clear names
Tell integers, floats, strings and booleans apart, and convert between them
Read what a user types with input() and use it in calculations
Build messages with f-strings and format numbers neatly
Pick text apart with indexing, slicing and string methods

lessons.title: Variables
lessons.summary: Give values names, change them, and watch Python keep track.

lessons.title: Kinds of data
lessons.summary: Meet integers, floats, strings and booleans, and convert between them.

lessons.title: Talking to the user
lessons.summary: Read what the user types, convert it, and build small interactive programs.

lessons.title: Working with text
lessons.summary: Format output with f-strings, pick text apart with indexes and slices, and use string methods.

gameSummary: Run the cargo bay of a space station: read details with input(), calculate, and print neat reports.
